name: OpenCode
description: Chat with OpenCode models over your notes, as a second backend of the Agent pane.

memory.note: Registers one entry for the Agent pane at startup. One opencode process starts per window with an OpenCode chat (or when Settings lists its models) and stops with the window; with the feature off nothing runs.

offNotes.agent.backends: New chats can't use OpenCode, and its chats won't open until you turn it back on
